newsitem.title: FINLAND: IVO sees lower 1997 power sales to Sweden, Norway.
newsitem.headline: IVO sees lower 1997 power sales to Sweden, Norway.

text.p: Finnish state-owned energy group Imatran Voima Oy (IVO) said on Thursday it expected its power sales to Sweden and Norway to fall in 1997 on 1996, when the countries' own energy output was reduced by dry weather.
"It is obvious that sales of surplus energy will not be as high as last year," IVO CEO Kalevi Numminen told a news conference.

"On the open Nordic power markets, price fluctuations seem to continue," IVO said in a statement. "IVO Group's power sales to the Nordic Power Exchange are expected to be lower than last year," it said.
